definitions.gloss: visiting a store; coming to a shop (honorific)
definitions.explanation: Honorific form used by shop staff addressing customers.

examples.japanese: ご{来店|らいてん}⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for visiting our store.

examples.japanese: ご{来店|らいてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ご⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: Please make a reservation when you visit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ご{来店|らいてん}⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you very much for visiting us today as well.

examples.japanese: ご{来店|らいてん}⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{上|あ}げます→差し上げる：01597_sashiageru⟧。
examples.english: We will give a gift to every customer who visits.

notes:
The honorific prefix ご + ⟦{来店|らいてん}→来店：13067_raiten⟧ (visiting a store). This is standard keigo used by service staff to politely refer to a customer's visit. You will hear this phrase in virtually every retail and restaurant environment in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{来店|らいてん}⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧: thank you for visiting
- ご{来店|らいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧: we look forward to your visit
- ご{来店|らいてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧: when you visit
- ご{来店|らいてん}⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: to have someone visit (humble/honorific)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ご⟦{来場|らいじょう}→来場：17703_raijou⟧: visiting a venue (events, exhibitions)
- ご{来院|らいいん}: visiting a hospital or clinic
- ご{来社|らいしゃ}: visiting a company office
- ご{来館|らいかん}: visiting a public facility (library, museum)
